scope.summary: Replace only the failed actions/download-artifact retrieval with direct authenticated REST GETs for the exact approved artifact ID. Application, publisher logic, successful Windows evidence and approved inner ZIP are unchanged.
before_design_requirements: Existing job-scoped GITHUB_TOKEN with actions:read, no alternate credential or signed-URL logging
Binary finite-timeout download, pinned complete outer SHA before archive parsing
Bounded safe unique archive paths, CRC and no symlinks, fresh owned extraction directory
Unchanged completed-review/inner-ZIP/source/publisher gates; 403 or mismatch stops before mutations
scope.approved_for: Evaluation prerelease delivery only, latest=false, after all actual downloader and publisher guards succeed.

reviewed_workflow.only_permitted_substitution: __PUBLISH_SOURCE__ -> immutable commit containing this unaltered addendum, original review JSON and reviewed publisher, without changing packaged application source.
reviewed_workflow.transport: gh api GET exact artifact metadata, then gh api GET its /zip endpoint. Job GH_TOKEN comes only from github.token; permissions remain actions:read and contents:write for the separately gated publisher.
archive_gates: Metadata id/name/run/head SHA/both repository IDs/expired false/exact byte size/server digest equal expected
Exclusive binary download file; no PowerShell text redirect
Actual file size and entire pinned SHA before ZipFile parsing
At most64 entries and64MiB total uncompressed header sizes
No symlink entries or duplicate/case-fold colliding paths
CRC test, then extraction into a newly created owned TEMP directory
reviewed_workflow.publisher: Unchanged publish_reconnect_candidate.py verifies the completed independent review binding, approved inner ZIP/source/manifest, eight non-Excel gates, expected COM gap and false equipment/stable flags before any release/tag mutation. It creates a draft evaluation prerelease, verifies tag/assets/server SHA, and publishes latest=false only after checks.
reviewed_workflow.auth_failure_policy: No PAT, alternate user token, permission workaround or signed-URL bypass. Any403, metadata/hash mismatch, timeout or extraction failure stops before the publisher step.

independent_checks_executed.method: Extracted exact Python here-string from the reviewed template; executed it under fully mocked subprocess.check_output and subprocess.run with the real approved outer artifact bytes and private test TEMP directories. No external process/API was called by these tests.
success_assertions: Exact outer archive metadata, size/SHA, CRC and safe extraction all succeed
Extracted inner ZIP SHA equals approved a341d2d92db06ed79becd2f2bfa8095b6eacc0d5970adb57e09f6a833cc71c85
Actual full verify_package on the extracted inner ZIP passes against unchanged application source
negative_assertions: Metadata and simulated403 failures never invoke binary download
Corrupted/short downloaded bytes never create the extraction directory
Existing download file is not overwritten
No publisher or external mutation invoked
independent_checks_executed.source_integrity: Every15 critical source-file hash matches the unchanged application review. Current repository differs from approved application commit only by the previously committed review JSON. Publisher file hash matches the original completed review.
